open_questions.question: STAGE3 / STAGE_REPORT name the seed as 'supply card adopted, displacing better robust_mad' (SUPPLY_DISPLACEMENT). The r2 artifact shows the opposite adoption: robust_mad was chosen, probed, POSITIVE, minted, and deployed; cand_skill_s2a_forecast_supply_v0 (hampel) is outcome=not_reached_support_budget_exhausted. The −0.1206 figure is A5(mad)−A3(hampel). Main line must re-state the seed (adoption vs first-positive-stop leaving supply unprobed vs in-view changing propose) before LLM-edit reads a false story.

Whether the A5 propose of mad (vs A3/K0 hampel on the same unit) was caused by the supply card being in view, or is LLM variance, is not identified in the artifact. Do not treat that causal story as fact.

S1 PHASE_ARM isolation token is s1_oracle only (run_e2_s1_curriculum_four_arms.py:87, :108-115). S2a oracle keys live under artifacts/functional/e2/s2a_oracle/. Whether s2a_oracle is mechanically blocked during PHASE_ARM is not shown in S2a runner code; freeze file only carries a banner string.

S2a does not call s1._arm_isolation. Four-arm isolation is structural (_new_state per unit/arm, Static skips _run_round) but not the S1 check function. Confirm whether that function is in the G3 isolation list for this pilot.

A parallel Fast Path exists in evaluation/functional/task_episode_harness/agentic/fast_path.py (LLM select after each probe, material-threshold mechanical gate). S2a does not call it. Stage 3 edits must name the TTHA online_loop/fast_agent loci; editing agentic fast_path would miss the seed path.

Whether first_positive_stop=false is Random-legal: it does not raise SUPPORT_TRIAL_BUDGET but raises expected probes spent (1→up to 2). Protocol says 不增减总预算; it does not say 必须花满. Needs a one-line ruling.
methods/ttha/ is a second tree besides SelfEvolvingHarnessTS/methods/ttha/. S2a imports the latter. This audit did not byte-compare the two trees.
